entries.title: Psalms 109:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

entries.title: Psalms 109:2
segments: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue. {of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit} {are opened: Heb. have opened themselves}

words.text: . {of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit} {are opened: Heb. have opened themselves}

entries.title: Psalms 109:3
segments: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 109:4
segments: For my love they are my adversaries: but I [give myself unto] prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 109:5
segments: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

entries.title: Psalms 109:6
segments: ¶Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand. {Satan: or, an adversary}

entries.title: Psalms 109:7
segments: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin. {be condemned: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked}

words.text: . {be condemned: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked}

entries.title: Psalms 109:8
segments: Let his days be few; [and] let another take his office. {office: or, charge}

entries.title: Psalms 109:9
segments: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

entries.title: Psalms 109:10
segments: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek [their bread] also out of their desolate places.

words.text: [their bread] also out of their desolate places

entries.title: Psalms 109:11
segments: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

words.text: all that he hath; and let the strangers

entries.title: Psalms 109:12
segments: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

words.text: Let there be none to extend
unto him: neither let there be any to favour

entries.title: Psalms 109:13
segments: Let his posterity be cut off; [and] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:14
segments: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:15
segments: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

words.text: Let them be before the LORD

entries.title: Psalms 109:16
segments: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 109:17
segments: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:18
segments: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones. {into his bowels: Heb. within him}

entries.title: Psalms 109:19
segments: Let it be unto him as the garment [which] covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

words.text: Let it be unto him as the garment

entries.title: Psalms 109:20
segments: [Let] this [be] the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 109:21
segments: ¶But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy [is] good, deliver thou me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:22
segments: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:23
segments: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

words.text: : I am tossed up and down

entries.title: Psalms 109:24
segments: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

entries.title: Psalms 109:25
segments: I became also a reproach unto them: [when] they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

entries.title: Psalms 109:26
segments: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

entries.title: Psalms 109:27
segments: That they may know that this [is] thy hand; [that] thou, LORD, hast done it.

entries.title: Psalms 109:28
segments: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 109:29
segments: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

entries.title: Psalms 109:30
segments: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

entries.title: Psalms 109:31
segments: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those that condemn his soul. {those...: Heb. the judges of}
